scope: Probes run before the safe-repair boundary contract was frozen, to choose its registered support. Not a study result, not a comparison and not a hardware claim. Scratch run directories were not retained; the case definitions here are sufficient to rebuild every request.

mount_compliance_does_not_defeat_compete.question: Does a finite-stiffness port mount leave a residual failure the competent first attempt cannot prevent?
mount_compliance_does_not_defeat_compete.design: force_guided_insertion, installed loop 4 mm, lateral stiffness {rigid, 8000, 4000, 2000, 1000} N/m crossed with lateral mounting offsets {0, 2, 4} mm. Axial stiffness is 6.25x lateral throughout.

layout_settling_screen.question: Which layout variations reach an accepted settled configuration at all?
layout_settling_screen.design: Three screens. First, run direction rotated with the cable exit rotated to match. Second, run direction rotated with the cable exit held at the registered free direction. Third, clip position along the shelf crossed with a lateral dogleg in the route, at the two extreme installed loops.

parametric_action_shakedown.question: Does the continuous clearance action produce a usable spread of outcomes?
parametric_action_shakedown.design: Two decision times crossed with retreat {0, 40, 80, 100} mm and four bearing/excursion combinations, at the registered clearance speed.

reading.mount_compliance: Every request completed with the required clip retained across an eightfold range of lateral mount stiffness crossed with mounting offsets. Compliance is not a fault on this observation interface, because every arm is handed the port's live pose at the servo rate and therefore tracks a target that moves under contact.
reading.layouts: Rotating the run direction together with the cable exit is fragile. Holding the exit at the registered free direction and varying the clip position and route is more robust. The five layouts the contract registers are the surviving families.
reading.parametric_action: The clearance action spans the boundary: outcomes include seating with the clip retained, clip release and load abort within the same grid, so the registered study is not measuring a degenerate space.

limitations: Exploratory: no pre-registration, no held-out split, no repeated seeds.
Settling rejections here are properties of a construction, not of a controller.
These counts are not comparable with the registered block's denominator.
